tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0096 1. Lemma 3.17\group deTurck-formulation

The variation of the Ricci tensor may be written as \[ D(\Rc _g)(h)=-\frac12\Delta _L h-\delta _g^*(\delta _g G(h)), \] where $G(h)=h-\frac12(\tr _g h)\, g$.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0096 \sketch Rearrange the standard linearization of $\Rc $ into its Lichnerowicz part and the divergence term involving the Einstein operator $G$.

□
